messages:
matthew: Hey team — our sandbox credits dropped to 0 in the middle of a scheduled load test. Calls started returning `quota_exhausted` and clients errored out. We were mid-run from 12:05–12:17 UTC, testing throughput. Can you check why trial credits expired early and whether they can be reinstated? Screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/err-1223.png

chloe (cs): Sorry about that — can you paste the account id and the request ids you saw? I can look up the billing timeline. Also was a promo code used at signup?

matthew: account: acct_84RVwq, request ids: `req_20260317_1206_aa` and `req_20260317_1210_bf`. Promo used was `NEWSTART-2026` during signup. We verified the promo on our end — it shows as applied in the dashboard but credits went to 0.

billing-bot: Promo `NEWSTART-2026` status: applied -> active on 2026-02-15, expires: 2026-03-15 00:00 UTC. Remaining credits: 0.

matthew: Wait — the promo expiry says Mar 15 UTC, but our run started Mar 17. We expected a 30-day trial from activation. Could the activation time have been recorded incorrectly?

chloe (cs): Hmm. Could be timezone or activation vs issuance discrepancy. Can you share the minimal repro curl you ran? I want to see any header timestamps.

matthew: Sure — snippet we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","prompt":"load test","max_tokens":256}'
```
Responses: `{"error":"quota_exhausted","code":402}` after ~1.6M tokens.

raj (billing): Looping in billing. Quick policy note: trial/promo credits expire at the promo expiry timestamp in UTC and cannot be auto-extended past policy. That said, we do manual reinstatements for clear platform issues or incorrect issuance.

sara (support): @raj — can you confirm whether the dashboard 'applied' state sometimes flips to active after first request? If we recorded activation earlier (Feb 15) but it shouldn't have started until first successful API call, that's a bug. If activation was accidental during test provisioning, we can consider reinstating.

raj (billing): I'll pull the activation logs. Give me a few minutes.

billing-bot: Billing log snippet for acct_84RVwq:
```
2026-02-15T03:12:08Z promo_applied id=promo_99 token=NEWSTART-2026 source=manual_ui user=matthew
2026-02-15T03:12:09Z promo_activated id=promo_99 trigger=trial_grant
2026-03-15T00:00:00Z promo_expired id=promo_99
```

chloe (cs): From that log it looks like activation happened on Feb 15 and expiry Mar 15 — that's 28 days, not 30. Might be a policy mismatch between the UI language and actual grant length.

matthew: We were told 30 days in the email and onboarding modal. If the system gave 28 days that's a problem for us — we scheduled tests based on docs. Appreciate any reinstatement to cover tokens consumed between Mar 15–Mar 17.

raj (billing): OK. Two things: 1) I'll open a manual credit adjustment to restore the tokens used in the window you reported (12:05–12:17 UTC on Mar 17). 2) We'll investigate why the promo activated Feb 15 instead of at first successful call. If there's a product bug we can reinstate additional credits and prioritize a fix.

matthew: Thanks. Can you also note this is blocking a customer demo tomorrow — speed would be appreciated.

chloe (cs): Noted. @raj marking as P1 for manual override. I'll confirm once adjustment is applied.

raj (billing): Manual credit adjustment queued: adj_88631 for acct_84RVwq -> 1.8M token units reinstated. ETA: 30–60 mins. Reason: premature promo activation/policy mismatch.

matthew: Confirmed the tokens appeared in dashboard. Thank you! Can you also confirm whether our promo code will be extended or whether we should expect expiry on Mar 15 next year?

raj (billing): We'll follow up with a formal policy clarification. For now, the reinstatement covers your demo. Separately, I'll add a doc note recommending we make UI messaging explicit about UTC-based expiry and activation semantics.

sara (support): Filing support ticket SR-2026-03-17-005 to track root cause and docs update.

matthew: Appreciate it. Small ask — can you also provide the list of request ids that consumed the 1.8M tokens so we can correlate in our logs?

chloe (cs): Sending via DM to avoid leaking ids in channel.

matthew: Got it. All good on our side, thanks for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
